text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (They were running.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Every time the girls my age showed their 
drive, I trembled too. I overflowed with 
energy... It made me want to do my best.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(I was watching the scenery beyond the 
glass.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the cherry blossoms began to bloom, the 
various media outlets published their 
predictions for the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Garnering solid support from the crowd is 
last year's champion, Mejiro Bright.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one expected to hold off even Mejiro 
Bright is the darling of the era, Special 
Week.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the third person is—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Tsuru-chan. Wanna train together 
next time? Spe-chan can join us too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky, one of the Big Three in the 
Tenno Sho (Spring). A front-running master 
who dictates the pace of the race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After receiving a message from Tsurumaru 
Tsuyoshi, I headed to the track, where a 
crowd of onlookers had already gathered.

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
To think the two favorites for the Tenno 
Sho (Spring) would run together...

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what will Seiun Sky do...? 
Special Week's late kick is terrifying, 
after all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The surrounding crowd paid remarkably 
little attention to the other training 
partner, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi still just evaluated 
as an opponent who happened to be there by 
chance...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's before the big race. To keep 
the strain light, how about 1600m on dirt?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. Could you please record 
this practice match for me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's energetic 
momentum, I took out the video camera to 
record the footage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having the three of them take their 
starting positions just like that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Signaled the start of the race.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru & Spe
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
W-Whaaat...!? Just what was up with that 
run of Seiun Sky's!?

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, you didn't run away at all! You 
stayed right on Special Week's tail! Are 
you planning to run as a front-runner?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Sei-chan can even win right from the 
start line~!?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Mmm, I wonder about that~?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~~?! Wh-What do we do?! Tsuru-chan, do 
you have a plan—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it! I'll do all of it! Even if 
this whole thing is a misleading trap!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ......Huuuh?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Once we pack up the equipment, we 
should check the video footage you 
recorded, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Tsu~ru-chan! ...Hey, hey!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: —Did that shake you?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Heh—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (—Those eyes...)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Those eyes were just like Bright's at the 
Fan Thanksgiving.)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What kind of training are we doing next~? 
...Want some help?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...! I-I'm fine! So keep it a secret!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
My training is... My anti-Sei-chan 
strategy is—a secret!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (I felt like I had to fight back.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the day of the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Howaa~. Lady Tsuru-chan has powered up 
too, hasn't she~?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Can you tell?! That's right! I've been 
training thoroughly!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. From muscle tone to overall balance. 
It truly looks built for long distances...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: You've come here to win, haven't you~?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I have no other thoughts on the 
matter.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Because—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Because you're no longer on the other 
side of the glass.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Standing on the very same ground, showing 
that I'm stronger. I'll compete with 
them... even against opponents I believe 
are truly strong.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Who I am now isn't about 'wanting to 
become rivals'..."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Because we're... rivals, after all.
